title: Distance from a graph point to the rotated coordinate plane
statement: For all natural numbers n, l, every linear isometry equivalence q of R^(n+l), every a in R^n and every b in R^l, the distance from q(graphPoint a b) to the rotated plane rotatedPlane q = q(horizontalPlane n l), regarded as a set, equals ||b||: infDist (q(graphPoint a b)) (rotatedPlane q) = ||b||.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (a : Rn n) (b : Rn ℓ), infDist (q (graphPoint a b)) (rotatedPlane q : Set (Amb n ℓ)) = ‖b‖
